whatsappMessage:
Hi Team The Food Panda Cloud Kitchen,

I noticed your cloud kitchen has stellar 4.8★ reviews in Sri Krishna Nagar, Patna, but lacked a dedicated mobile ordering page for direct food deliveries.

Maine aapke kitchen ke liye ek custom live website concept design kiya hai — jisme direct WhatsApp menu ordering, dish categories, aur fast delivery highlights integrate kiye hain:

🔗 https://www.arclanestudios.space/sites/foodpanda

Aapko overall look aur concept kaisa laga? Would love your honest feedback!

— Ameya Sharma, Arclane Studios
callScript: Hi The Food Panda Cloud Kitchen team, Ameya here from Arclane Studios. Maine aapke business ke liye ek custom live website concept banakar WhatsApp par share kiya tha. Bas ek minute check karna tha ki kya aapko link receive hua aur aapne demo glance kiya? Great! We tailored it specifically with direct WhatsApp menu ordering and a showcase of your top-rated Patna kitchen specialties. Aapko overall look aur concept kaisa laga? Agar aapko design direction pasand aaye, to hum isme aapki actual menu items, prices, aur online ordering setup integrate karke live kar sakte hain. Jab bhi aap free hon batayein, we can connect on a quick 5-minute walkthrough.
